get.description: Returns all goals for one or more websites.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"

parameters.name: orderByName
parameters.description: Whether to sort the returned goals alphabetically by name.

200.description:
Goal attributes, indexed by goal ID for single-site requests and returned as a numeric list for multi-site requests.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Creates a goal for a website.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to configure the goal for.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Goal name.

parameters.name: matchAttribute
parameters.description: Attribute used to match conversions.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Match pattern. Use a URL, title, filename, external website, or event value for string match attributes; use a numeric threshold for visit duration, actions, or pageview match attributes; this value is ignored for `manually`.

parameters.name: patternType
parameters.description: Matching operator. Numeric match attributes only accept `greater_than`; string match attributes accept `exact`, `contains`, or `regex`; use an empty string for `manually`.

parameters.name: caseSensitive
parameters.description: Whether string matching should be case-sensitive.

parameters.name: revenue
parameters.description: Default revenue to assign to conversions. Pass `false` or `0` to disable a fixed revenue value.

parameters.name: allowMultipleConversionsPerVisit
parameters.description: Whether multiple conversions may be recorded within one visit.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional goal description shown in the Goals management UI.

parameters.name: useEventValueAsRevenue
parameters.description: Whether to use the tracked event value as goal revenue. This is only valid for event-based goals.

200.description:
ID of the new goal.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns ecommerce product metrics grouped by product SKU.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: abandonedCarts
parameters.description: Whether to return abandoned-cart product metrics instead of purchased products.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

200.description:
Ecommerce product metrics grouped by SKU.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

tags.name: Goals
tags.description: Goals API lets you Manage existing goals, via "updateGoal" and "deleteGoal", create new Goals via "addGoal", or list existing Goals for one or several websites via "getGoals" If you are tracking Ecommerce orders and products on your site, the functions "getItemsSku", "getItemsName" and "getItemsCategory" will return the list of products purchased on your site, either grouped by Product SKU, Product Name or Product Category. For each name, SKU or category, the following metrics are returned: Total revenue, Total quantity, average price, average quantity, number of orders (or abandoned carts) containing this product, number of visits on the Product page, Conversion rate. By default, these functions return the 'Products purchased'. These functions also accept an optional parameter &abandonedCarts=1. If the parameter is set, it will instead return the metrics for products that were left in an abandoned cart therefore not purchased. The API also lets you request overall Goal metrics via the method "get": Conversions, Visits with at least one conversion, Conversion rate and Revenue. If you wish to request specific metrics about Ecommerce goals, you can set the parameter &idGoal=ecommerceAbandonedCart to get metrics about abandoned carts (including Lost revenue, and number of items left in the cart) or &idGoal=ecommerceOrder to get metrics about Ecommerce orders (number of orders, visits with an order, subtotal, tax, shipping, discount, revenue, items ordered) See also the documentation about Tracking Goals in Matomo.
